title: Multiplayer Strategy Game (6 Months Dev)
author: Kulimar
selftext:
[https://kulimar.itch.io/clouds](https://kulimar.itch.io/clouds)

This was a small side project I've been working on over the last 6 months based on a game I designed in college. All prototyped using Gemini and Claude. Hand tuned via json files featuring P2P multiplayer.

I worked with an artist on all of the pixel art.

I mainly started it as a test to see if the tools were good enough to implement a turn-based multiplayer game with layers upon layers of technical rules. It was very cool to see how far the tools have come and look forward to showing off some much more ambitious projects I have in-progress once I finish iterating on this a bit more.

Any feedback on the play experience would be great, as I still plan to work on this little by little on the side.

\-\~-
